review_scope: One combined read-only review of all 28 controls and the actual draft scripts; no native behavior verdicts.

findings.title: The case sets an invalid concurrency limit and is rejected before launch
findings.evidence: Run.MaxConcurrentOtherGames is 0. The pinned run_case rejects limits outside 1..100, and flow_run has ValidateRange(1,100). No reviewed command-line override is supplied.
findings.impact: The stated runner exits with code 2 before Setup or native evidence capture.
findings.action: For the intended zero-other-game policy, disable AllowConcurrentGames and remove the invalid 0 override while retaining strict ownership. If a different concurrency policy is intended, supply a valid reviewed limit and state that policy explicitly.

findings.title: Ten controls have context aliases that cannot resolve
findings.evidence: Eleven context records use SC02=true, SC03=true or SH02=true as override.alias. Captured baseline keys and native aliases are SC02, SC03 and SH02. Get-PhaseCommands requires override.alias in baseline.Keys and constructs set commands from it literally.
findings.impact: The first SC03 positive phase throws missing captured context baseline SC02=true. Fixing only the membership check would emit an invalid alias and still break captured-value restoration.
findings.action: Store plain alias names in context_overrides and retain the Boolean in value. Validate every context alias against the 30 declared aliases before any native setter, including the emergency restore map.

findings.title: Numeric-only phase names collide across the three families
findings.evidence: Get-PhaseName discards the qualified ID prefix. Duplicate suffix groups are 0002 SC02/SH02, 0003 SC03/SH03, 0004 SC04/SH04, 0006 SC06/SH06, and 0008 SC08/SH08/E08. The 84 target phases produce only 66 unique receipt names.
findings.impact: After the context records are corrected, SH02 attempts phase_0002_positive.cfg, which already belongs to SC02, and Execute refuses the overwrite before its setter. The complete batch cannot finish.
findings.action: Use the unique alias or a filesystem-safe full ID in phase names, and check uniqueness of the complete planned command/frame receipt namespace before launch.

findings.title: The completion-event requester has no producer in the pinned harness
findings.evidence: The requester opens Local\BurnoutPC_HarnessPhaseDone_<pid>_<slot>_<startTicks>. No supplied draft creates this event. The exact pinned a6e4457 flow_run/run_case helpers and tools tree contain no PhaseDone or BurnoutPC_HarnessPhaseDone producer; the pinned B5 source has none either.
findings.impact: With the declared helper binding, OpenExisting fails even after successful capture. Driver catch then saves status=fail over the success result, and the harness lacks the claimed early completion request.
findings.action: Bind the actual compatible harness or wrapper that creates and polls this PID/slot/start-time event, include it in the review and hash pins, and use its exact stop contract. Preserve ownership checks and avoid a global input or process-stop substitute.

findings.title: The reviewed Case.ps1 is not the Case.ps1 recorded in SOURCE_PINS
findings.evidence: SOURCE_PINS records 174361320e6e2e25cf6c881b16bde846c88789612b07009823f5fac8398353cc for Case.ps1. The actual reviewed bytes hash to ec696287037e99d2dd3f80a129895c98e630bad5add3553d523651fdb7557021. The other seven copied helper hashes match.
findings.impact: The package cannot identify its actual reviewed runner through its own manifest.
findings.action: After deliberate fixes, refresh the hash of the actual final Case.ps1 and any other changed packet files; preserve a review manifest for the final bytes and reject mismatches before launch.

findings.title: Rounded Scene readbacks do not prove an exact same-run float baseline
findings.evidence: Variant::ConvertToString renders floats with %.3f. Test-RestorableBaseline compares that rounded display to the source default, then restores the same display string. For example TriX=0.0004 displays 0.000, passes the default-0 check, and is restored to 0.0; scale 1.0004 and padding 0.3004 have the same defect. Published source also supports typed INI overrides, so fresh process construction alone does not establish the assumed exact value.
findings.impact: The driver can report terminal_restore_verified while changing the natural f32 bits. Unlike the clipping controls, the Scene floats have no exact baseline read.
findings.action: Capture and verify actual f32 bits for these five fields, or establish an independently checked exact fresh-default provenance before mutation. Otherwise skip those fields without writing. A rounded default comparison alone must not authorize a write.

findings.title: A NaN float readback bypasses the mutation and restore comparison
findings.evidence: Read-Values does not parse or validate f32 values; it assigns an unused NaN variable. Execute accepts a parsed actual NaN because Abs(want-NaN) > tolerance is false, so its compound mismatch condition is false. The clip baseline display comparison has the same NaN comparison shape.
findings.impact: A finite requested value can receive a successful phase/restore receipt despite a non-finite native value string.
findings.action: Require invariant-culture numeric parsing and IsFinite-equivalent checks on every f32 raw readback before comparison or baseline acceptance. Reject NaN and infinities explicitly; retain the independent exact-bit restore checks.

findings.title: E14 has a known downstream implementation gap, beyond an unobserved jump scene
findings.evidence: Published 3f MomentPlayerJumping checks jump-action, can-use-slomo and mbAllowJumpMoment, then calls PrepareCameras and asserts success. BehaviourCollection::Prepare calls PlayerJumpingTrap and returns false. The packet pins the common UpdateMoments/UpdateAllMoments handoff, but omits this known terminal consumer gap.
findings.impact: A genuine eligible E14 jump attempt can reach an existing PC trap/assert. A field P/N run cannot establish working jump-moment behavior on this source.
findings.action: Pin the terminal jump consumer and record E14 as pending with a known implementation blocker. Keep its mutation-only evidence separate; do not attempt to award behavior credit until the filming closure is implemented and the relevant native scenario is witnessed.

notes.text: All eight f32 probes are finite, and the selected Source41/ARTIST registrations have the listed steps with no explicit SetRange. SC08 negative=0.0 is -1.2 increments from its source default 0.3 at step 0.25, so the blanket claim that every probe follows default-relative increments is false. An explicit typed SET can still accept 0.0; either document that route or choose a default-relative step value such as 0.05.

RUNTIME_GATES lists source conditions but Driver eligibility checks only baseline restorability. Case throttle input ends at 10 seconds, while Driver waits 12 seconds after its speed witness before setup. There are no phase-local jump/stunt/hard-stop/crash/boost attempts or camera-cycle/close-object/landmark gates. E43 explicitly has no pinned producer for bit 0x10000. Treat every missing producer, empty cache, absent shadow receiver or unobserved consumer as pending; no no-op or behavior credit follows from this run plan.

SC02 requires a false interval to seed the camera anchor. The draft captures an arbitrary natural Boolean baseline and does not require SC02=false before its first positive capture. Require that baseline or account for an explicit seed/restore phase before interpreting the first SC02 positive image.

The nominal budget is valid: 1 natural + 28*3 target + 1 terminal + 1 post-restore = 87, below 90. Capture-PhaseRaw rejects a 91st requested frame; Assert-NativeBatchFrame and Complete-NativeBatchCaptureAudit reject recorded overrun and enforce BMP size/hash checks. These are static checks, not evidence of any produced frame.
